caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica will eventually ask you to get off the saddle and walk. Tropical climbs don't follow gentle switchbacks; they trace old ridgelines and cattle paths that go straight up the mountain. When the afternoon mist softens the clay, pushing your bike isn't a defeat—it's simply how the mountain asks for your patience. You listen, you keep moving, and the canopy opens up when you earn it.
